Welcome to the scientific and technical wiki for iLand. This section details the ecological processes, mathematical formulations, and settings definitions implemented in the model.

### Key Sections:

*   **[Growth & Carbon Allocation](growth.qmd)**
    *   Learn about primary production, allocation to plant compartments, and stem growth.
    *   Detailed equations are available on the [Allocation](allocation.qmd) page.
*   **[Disturbances & Modules](fire-module.qmd)**
    *   Technical details of the wildfire, wind, and bark beetle sub-modules.
    *   For example, check out the [Fire Module Settings](fire-module.qmd) for parameters and scripting callbacks.
*   **Landscape Parameterization & Initialization**
    *   Information on project files, species parameters, and GIS layers.
